title: Values only in tables (read_table), pipe and space-aligned
about: The stability narrative gives no numbers. The long-term and accelerated values are in table 2 on page 3 (pipes). The shelf life is in a two-column table on page 4. The site is in a space-aligned table.

3.2.P.8.1 Summary

Three primary batches were placed on stability in the proposed commercial pack. The studies, their conditions and their durations are given in Table 2. All results stayed within specification at every time point. The conclusion is in Table 3.

3.2.P.8.3 Stability data

Table 1. Batches placed on stability

| Batch | Date of manufacture | Pack |
| QN-001 | March 2025 | Alu/Alu blister |
| QN-002 | March 2025 | Alu/Alu blister |
| QN-003 | April 2025 | Alu/Alu blister |

Table 2. Studies

| Study | Storage condition | Temperature (C) | Relative humidity (%) | Months of data |
| Long-term | 25 C / 60% RH | 25 | 60 | 12 |
| Intermediate | 30 C / 65% RH | 30 | 65 | 6 |
| Accelerated | 40 C / 75% RH | 40 | 75 | 6 |

Assay, related substances and dissolution met the acceptance criteria at every time point.

3.2.P.8.4 Conclusion

Table 3. Proposed shelf life and storage statement

| Item | Proposal |
| Proposed shelf life | 24 months |
| Storage statement | Do not store above 25 C |
